summary: The sample implements the requested Python LangChain-style agent, seeds example correspondent/sanctions/adverse-media documents with embeddings, runs client-side similarity search, computes a risk score and returns matches plus a plain-language narrative. It is runnable locally (seed, tests, example run succeeded with deterministic embeddings when OPENAI_API_KEY was absent). Key gaps: the sample intentionally avoids creating a server-side vector index and therefore does not exercise $search / cosmosSearch vector queries or publish IaC for the managed DocumentDB cluster. Several documentation items (index creation syntax & parameters, recommended createIndex example, and index tuning guidance) are missing or left to the user; these are documented below as recommended fixes.

requirement_results.requirement: Provide a Python LangChain agent that carries out the correspondent review: embedding profiles, searching the watchlist data and producing the per-correspondent result.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/agent.py:93-135 (review_correspondent returns risk_score, matches, risk_narrative).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: Embed correspondent bank entity profiles with a LangChain embeddings integration and store each profile's vector on its document in Azure DocumentDB using a MongoDB-compatible Python driver (e.g. pymongo).
requirement_results.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:49-54 (embeddings added to correspondent docs and upserted into DocumentDB); app/src/embeddings.py:6,16-24 uses OpenAI via openai. The code uses pymongo (app/src/db.py:11) as the MongoDB driver.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Add langchain-community (or adjust requirements) and/or change src/embeddings.py to prefer LangChain's OpenAIEmbeddings when available. Alternatively, document that the sample intentionally uses the openai client as a supported fallback; to strictly meet the checklist, add langchain-community to requirements.txt and update embed module to call LangChain first.

requirement_results.requirement: Store sanctions list entries and adverse media entries as documents in Azure DocumentDB, each with its embedding on the document.
requirement_results.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:56-64 and 66-74 (embeddings computed and coll.replace_one with upsert=True for sanctions and adverse_media).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: Create a cosmosSearch vector index (kind vector-ivf, vector-hnsw or vector-diskann) on the embedding field in code, with dimensions matching the embedding model used.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/db.py:19-22 (docstring: sample is conservative and computes similarity client-side); safe_create_indexes only creates simple PK indexes (app/src/db.py:24-27). No server-side vector index createIndex is present.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Provide an agent-kit-verified createIndex snippet (or add a controlled, opt-in create_vector_index function) that uses a dimension constant derived from the embedding module. Prefer adding the verified createIndex example to the DocumentDB agent kit and an opt-in code path (e.g. ENABLE_VECTOR_INDEX env var) so builders don't attempt unverified parameters by default.

requirement_results.requirement: On each review cycle, run vector similarity search inside Azure DocumentDB with $search / cosmosSearch, using each correspondent's embedding as the query vector against the embedded sanctions list and adverse media entries.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/agent.py:109-116 (search is implemented client-side with _search_collection_by_embedding reading stored 'embedding' fields and computing cosine similarity in Python). No $search / cosmosSearch calls or server-side vector query operators are used.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Add an opt-in server-side path that runs $search/cosmosSearch when a verified index exists (controlled by env var or config). Ship a tested agent-kit snippet demonstrating the exact createIndex & $search invocation for the managed DocumentDB so samples can enable it safely.

requirement_results.requirement: Derive a risk score for each correspondent from the similarity search results returned by Azure DocumentDB.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/agent.py:43-50 (compute_risk_score implements a simple heuristic mapping similarity to 0-100). The score is derived from similarity results, but those similarities are computed client-side rather than returned by Azure DocumentDB.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: When adding server-side search, adapt compute_risk_score to accept server-supplied scores and document the mapping; for now, document that compute_risk_score consumes similarity scores from whichever path (server or client) is configured.

requirement_results.requirement: Return, for each correspondent reviewed, the risk score, the matched sanctions list and adverse media entries, and a plain-language risk narrative written by the agent.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/agent.py:131-135 (return includes 'risk_score', 'matches', and 'risk_narrative'). Narrative generation present at app/src/agent.py:53-65 (LLM path) and 66-81 (deterministic fallback).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: The connection string and model credentials come from environment variables; none appear in the repository.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/db.py:5 (DOCUMENT_DB = os.environ.get('DOCUMENTDB_URI')); app/src/embeddings.py:9-13 (OPENAI_API_KEY required). No secrets in repo; app/.env.example lists placeholders.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: A `.env.example` lists every setting with placeholder values.
requirement_results.evidence: app/.env.example:2-5 includes DOCUMENTDB_URI, OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_BASE. However agent.py supports an LLM_MODEL env var (app/src/agent.py:17) and the README mentions seeds/flags that are not enumerated in .env.example.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Add LLM_MODEL and any opt-in flags (e.g. ENABLE_VECTOR_INDEX or ENABLE_SERVER_SEARCH) to .env.example with placeholders and comments.

requirement_results.requirement: The vector index dimensions match the embedding model's output.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/embeddings.py:6 documents MODEL_NAME = 'text-embedding-3-small' and comments '1536 dims' and the synthetic embedding uses dim=1536 (app/src/agent.py:84-90). No server-side vector index is created, so no index dimensions exist on the server to check.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Add an explicit EMBEDDING_DIM constant in src/embeddings.py and use it when creating any server-side index (or in index-creation snippet shipped via agent kit). Provide a tested createIndex example that sets 'dimensions' to that constant.

requirement_results.requirement: The vector index parameters are chosen for the sample's data size, and the README says how to change them for a larger one.
requirement_results.evidence: app/README.md:35-36 recommends creating a proper vector index for production but contains no concrete parameter recommendations, and the code purposely avoids creating cluster-specific vector indexes (app/src/db.py:20-22).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Add a README section giving example index parameters for small/medium/large datasets and show how to tune 'm', 'efConstruction' (HNSW) or IVF parameters; include a note about costs and tests.

requirement_results.requirement: One database client is created and reused across requests.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/db.py:11-12 client = MongoClient(DOCUMENT_DB); db = client[DB_NAME]. get_collection returns db[name] for reuse.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: A seed script loads sample data and creates the index, and can be run twice without duplicating data.
requirement_results.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:43-54,61-64,71-73 uses coll.replace_one(..., upsert=True) for idempotent seeding; safe_create_indexes() is called at start (app/scripts/seed.py:44).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: /search returns a clear error for an empty query and when the embedding call fails.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/main.py:19-25 maps ValueError from review_correspondent to HTTP 400; review_correspondent raises ValueError if both correspondent_id and profile_text are missing (app/src/agent.py:93-101). However embedding failures are caught and the code falls back to deterministic synthetic_embedding (app/src/agent.py:103-108) rather than returning an error.
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Decide desired behavior and document it: either return a 500 with a clear error on embedding failure, or keep the deterministic fallback but document it in the README and the API spec. For strict compliance, change review_correspondent to raise a 502/500 on embedding exceptions instead of automatically falling back.

requirement_results.requirement: Search results include the similarity score.
requirement_results.evidence: app/src/agent.py:120-129 (formatted output entries include 'score': float(m['score'])). Example output printed by scripts/run_example.py in events.jsonl shows scores (events.jsonl:41).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: n/a

requirement_results.requirement: Dependencies are pinned in `requirements.txt`.
requirement_results.evidence: app/requirements.txt pins fastapi==0.95.2 and uvicorn==0.22.0; pymongo uses a constrained range pymongo>=4.3,<5.0; other packages use >= ranges rather than exact pins (langchain>=0.0.300, openai>=0.27.6).
requirement_results.smallest_fix: Pin the set of dependencies to specific versions (e.g. use == for each) in requirements.txt for reproducible installs.

checks.practice: Require the DocumentDB connection string to be supplied from the DOCUMENTDB_URI environment variable at runtime and provide a .env.example placeholder instead of committing secrets.
checks.evidence: app/src/db.py:5 (reads DOCUMENTDB_URI); app/.env.example:2 (placeholder shown).

checks.practice: Create and reuse a single MongoClient instance for the process (module-level client) and use it for all collection access.
checks.evidence: app/src/db.py:11-12 (client = MongoClient(...); db = client[DB_NAME]); get_collection returns db[name].

checks.practice: Create simple primary-key/identity indexes for collections (correspondents, sanctions, adverse_media) on startup to support lookups.
checks.evidence: app/src/db.py:24-27 creates pk_correspondents, pk_sanctions, pk_adverse_media within safe_create_indexes().

checks.practice: For production, create a proper server-side vector index (e.g., HNSW/IVF/DiskANN) on the embedding field rather than relying on client-side similarity.
checks.evidence: app/src/db.py:20-22 and README.md:35-36 intentionally avoid creating server-side vector indexes; agent implements client-side similarity (app/src/agent.py:28-40).
checks.fix: Add an opt-in create_vector_index function (with verified parameters) and document how to enable it. Ship a tested agent-kit snippet for creating a vector index.

checks.practice: Make the seed operation idempotent by using upserts (replace_one / upsert=True) so repeated runs do not create duplicates.
checks.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:51-54,61-64,71-73 (coll.replace_one(..., upsert=True)).

checks.practice: Provide a deterministic synthetic-embedding fallback (used for seeding and runtime when OPENAI_API_KEY is not present) so the sample can run without external keys and produce reproducible vectors.
checks.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:24-31 defines synthetic_embedding; app/src/agent.py:84-90 defines synthetic_embedding used at runtime; TRY_USE_API logic in scripts/seed.py handles fallback.

checks.practice: Exclude or do not return full embeddings in API responses; compute similarity server- or client-side but omit embedding bytes from the public result payload.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:120-129 formats matches and does NOT include the raw 'embedding' field in returned objects; stored documents retain embeddings but responses omit them.

checks.practice: Limit the sample to a dedicated database name (sample_banking_11) and avoid touching other databases in the cluster.
checks.evidence: app/src/db.py:6 DB_NAME = 'sample_banking_11' and code uses db = client[DB_NAME]. README reiterates constraint (app/README.md:11-14).

checks.practice: Include TLS in the example connection string (ssl=true) to suggest encrypted connections in the sample configuration.
checks.evidence: app/.env.example:2 includes '?ssl=true' in the placeholder connection string.

checks.practice: When a server-side vector index cannot be created automatically, compute vector similarity client-side (numpy) as a fallback so the sample remains portable across clusters.
checks.evidence: app/README.md:35-36 documents the client-side fallback; app/src/agent.py:28-40 and _search_collection_by_embedding perform numpy-based similarity.

checks.practice: Handle failures to create indexes gracefully (catch PyMongoError and warn) instead of crashing the application during startup.
checks.evidence: app/src/db.py:23-29 safe_create_indexes wraps create_index calls in try/except PyMongoError and prints a warning on failure.

checks.practice: Ensure the data-plane account used for seeding and runtime allows writes and the cluster is reachable before attempting seeding or queries.
checks.evidence: README.md:23 notes the cluster must be reachable and allow data-plane writes; scripts/seed.py and scripts/run_seed.py are used to exercise the connection (events show seed run and pymongo warnings).

checks.practice: Store embeddings as lists of floats in a dedicated 'embedding' field on documents (the sample stores 1536-dim embeddings in an 'embedding' field).
checks.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:51-54,61-63,71-73 assigns doc['embedding'] = emb before upsert; app/src/embeddings.py and synthetic_embedding use 1536 dims.

checks.practice: Separate responsibilities: compute embeddings in a dedicated module (src/embeddings.py) and call them from the seeding and runtime code so embedding logic is centralized.
checks.evidence: app/src/embeddings.py provides embed_text and embed_texts; scripts/seed.py imports embed_texts (or uses local fallback) and src/agent.py imports embed_text/embed_texts.

checks.practice: Provide both seeding and runtime paths that fall back to deterministic embeddings so CI/DEV environments can run without external API keys.
checks.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py:34-41 TRY_USE_API logic; app/src/agent.py:103-108 catches embedding exceptions and uses synthetic_embedding.

checks.practice: When computing runtime similarity in the client, fetch only documents that have an 'embedding' field and project the minimal fields required for scoring.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:30-31 uses coll.find({'embedding': {'$exists': True}}, { 'embedding': 1, '_id': 1, 'title': 1, 'entry_text': 1, 'snippet': 1, 'source': 1, 'date': 1 }).

checks.practice: Format and cap returned matches (e.g., top 10) and present only selected metadata (id, title, score, source, date) rather than raw documents.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:121-129 formats matches and returns top 10 (all_matches[:10]).

checks.practice: Use a deterministic, testable narrative fallback when an LLM is not available (produce a deterministic plain-language summary based on scores and matches).
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:65-81 provides deterministic narrative fallback when LLM is not available.

checks.practice: Document the quickstart steps: install, set environment variables (using .env.example), run seed script, and run the API using uvicorn.
checks.evidence: app/README.md:18-32 contains quickstart steps including install, env vars, seed, run API and example request.

checks.practice: Separate seeding and runtime concerns (seed script computes and stores embeddings; runtime recomputes query embedding and searches against stored vectors).
checks.evidence: app/scripts/seed.py computes and stores embeddings (lines 49-74); app/src/agent.py computes query embedding at runtime (app/src/agent.py:103-108).

checks.practice: If server-side vector search is not used, perform straightforward client-side re-ranking using cosine similarity over stored embeddings as a simple and portable approach.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:_search_collection_by_embedding and cosine_similarity functions (app/src/agent.py:20-40) perform client-side cosine re-ranking.

checks.practice: Log warnings and progress during seeding (the seed script prints seeded counts and warns on index creation failures) to help troubleshoot provisioning.
checks.evidence: scripts/seed.py prints 'Seeded X ...' (app/scripts/seed.py:54,64,74) and src/db.py prints a warning on index failure (app/src/db.py:28-29).

checks.practice: Provide example usage for the API endpoint (/review) and examples for calling it with either a correspondent_id or inline profile_text.
checks.evidence: app/README.md:31-32 and app/src/main.py defines POST /review and README shows example payloads.

checks.practice: Use a small deterministic test fixture in unit tests (tests/test_agent.py uses small mocked embeddings and documents) to avoid network dependency in CI.
checks.evidence: app/tests/test_agent.py:23-56 patches embed_text and get_collection to provide synthetic docs/embeddings.

checks.practice: Centralize the LLM usage behind an optional dependency: use LangChain if available and fall back to deterministic text generation if not.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:9-16 attempts to import langchain ChatOpenAI; sets LLM_AVAILABLE flag and falls back to deterministic narrative when not available.

checks.practice: If an LLM is used, make it optional and controlled by the presence of the OPENAI_API_KEY so the system can run without LLM access in test/dev environments.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:53-55 uses OPENAI_API_KEY presence and LLM_AVAILABLE to decide whether to call ChatOpenAI; fallback path used when key is absent.

checks.practice: Keep vector dimensionality consistent across seeding and runtime (the sample uses a 1536-dim embedding model and the synthetic generator uses 1536 dims).
checks.evidence: app/src/embeddings.py:6 comment '1536 dims'; app/scripts/seed.py:24-31 synthetic_embedding uses dim=1536; app/src/agent.py synthetic_embedding default dim=1536.

checks.practice: When computing cosine similarity, guard against zero-length vectors and return a safe default score (the sample returns 0 when a vector norm is zero).
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:20-25 (cosine_similarity returns 0.0 when either vector norm is zero).

checks.practice: Present a capped number of top matches (e.g., top_k per collection and then global top-N) to limit response size and computation.
checks.evidence: app/src/agent.py:_search_collection_by_embedding uses top_k param with default 5 and review_correspondent returns top 10 global results (app/src/agent.py:28-40 and 121-129).

decision_reviews.comment: Approval with readiness 'ready_with_gaps' is an operator decision; events show the run proceeded with acknowledged gaps. Evidence: decisions.jsonl (D001).
Choice of Python with FastAPI aligns with the prompt and the implementation (app/src/main.py uses FastAPI). Evidence: decisions.jsonl D002 and events showing src/main.py created (events.jsonl:19).
Choosing pymongo>=4.3,<5.0 is consistent with code and requirements.txt (app/requirements.txt:3). The chosen pinned range is reasonable for MongoDB 7.x compatibility.

Decision to compute similarity client-side is implemented and documented (app/src/agent.py client-side cosine similarity; README notes the deliberate choice). The readiness report and missing agent-kit justify the choice.
Choosing text-embedding-3-small is implemented (app/src/embeddings.py:6). Decision originated from model_default, but the repository reflects that choice.
LLM default gpt-4o-mini is present in app/src/agent.py:17 and used when LangChain/OPENAI_API_KEY are available.

Secrets read from env vars DOCUMENTDB_URI and OPENAI_API_KEY is implemented (app/src/db.py and app/src/embeddings.py) and .env.example documents placeholders. Note: an earlier log attempt used 'skill.md' as reason_source and produced a validation exception in events.jsonl:6; the recorded D007 later used readiness_report as the reason_source (events.jsonl:8).

Builder switched from LangChain embeddings to using the openai client due to a missing langchain_community module during test runs; events show pytest import error and a subsequent rewrite of src/embeddings.py to use openai (events.jsonl:26,27). The change is reflected in the repository.
The decision to run the seed script against the live cluster was executed and recorded; events show scripts/run_seed.py ran and seeded documents (events.jsonl:36).
Deterministic synthetic embeddings for seeding when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent were implemented and used by the seed run (app/scripts/seed.py and events.jsonl:36).
Fallback to deterministic synthetic embeddings for runtime queries when OPENAI_API_KEY is missing is implemented (app/src/agent.py:103-108) and exercised during example run (events.jsonl:41).

doc_gaps.what_was_missing: A verified, copy-paste createIndex example for the managed Azure DocumentDB cluster (exact createIndex parameters, option names and an example for HNSW/IVF/DiskANN).
doc_gaps.where_searched: Repository files and run environment; no external documentation server was reachable in this run (documentation_search_available: false).
doc_gaps.effect_on_this_build: The builder avoided creating server-side vector indexes and implemented client-side similarity as a fallback. This prevents the sample from demonstrating server-side $search/cosmosSearch vector queries and leaves index tuning to users.
doc_gaps.proposed_content: Agent kit / documentation page titled 'Create a vector index on Azure DocumentDB (MongoDB 7 style)'. Outline: short intro, exact createIndex code snippets for HNSW, IVF and DiskANN with parameters (dimensions variable), example Python pymongo call to create index, verification commands to list indexes, and a tested script that can be run against the managed cluster. Provide an opt-in env var example (ENABLE_VECTOR_INDEX=true) and a note about costs and recommended parameters for small/medium/large datasets.

doc_gaps.what_was_missing: Concrete guidance in the README on which vector index parameters to choose for different dataset sizes and how to adapt parameters.
doc_gaps.where_searched: README.md and other repository files. No external docs accessible in this run.
doc_gaps.effect_on_this_build: Left users without guidance on how to tune index parameters for production workloads; the sample deliberately avoids creating such indexes without guidance.
doc_gaps.proposed_content: Add a 'Vector index tuning' subsection to the README explaining typical parameter defaults for small (<=10k), medium (10k-1M) and large (>1M) datasets, with example HNSW/IVF parameter sets and tradeoffs (latency vs memory vs recall).

doc_gaps.what_was_missing: A single canonical place documenting the chosen embedding model and its vector dimension (so index dimension and synthetic fallbacks must match it).
doc_gaps.where_searched: app/src/embeddings.py and other repository files; no external docs reachable.
doc_gaps.effect_on_this_build: Builder selected text-embedding-3-small and used 1536 dims, but without an authoritative doc consumers might alter embedding model without updating index code.
doc_gaps.proposed_content: README 'Configuration' section itemizing MODEL_NAME and EMBEDDING_DIM (e.g., MODEL_NAME=text-embedding-3-small, EMBEDDING_DIM=1536) and advising where to change these constants for other models. Recommend making EMBEDDING_DIM available as a single source of truth in code.

doc_gaps.what_was_missing: Optional environment variables used by the code (LLM_MODEL, ENABLE_VECTOR_INDEX/ENABLE_SERVER_SEARCH) were not listed in .env.example.
doc_gaps.effect_on_this_build: Users may not realize optional flags exist to enable server-side index creation or change the LLM model name.
doc_gaps.proposed_content: Update .env.example to list LLM_MODEL, OPENAI_API_BASE (already present), and optional toggles like ENABLE_VECTOR_INDEX and ENABLE_SERVER_SEARCH with placeholders and comments explaining their use.
